scope: C++ inference engine batch>1: packed prefill + continuous decode

design.kv_namespaces: per-sequence KV block tables over shared paged pool (kv_alloc_slot/kv_free_slot, kMaxBatchSeqs=64); slot 0 reserved for single-seq path
design.prefill: forward_batch_hidden packs all spans' tokens into shared GEMMs; attention is per-span causal with own KV namespace — no cross-sequence leakage
design.decode: one packed forward per step over active sequences; EOS/max removes seq and frees its KV blocks immediately (continuous batching)
design.isolation: single-seq forward_hidden delegates to packed path with one span; reset_cache re-activates slot 0

validation.cl_syntax: engine.cpp + binding.cpp compile clean under MSVC 19.51 /std:c++17
validation.tests: 22 passed in 7.52s (4 new: sequential-parity, unequal-length parity, fail-closed, MoE batch parity)
validation.parity: greedy batch output bitwise-identical to per-prompt sequential generate (dense + MoE bundles)
validation.pool_reuse: second identical batch reuses freed blocks — kv_memory_bytes unchanged
validation.forward_reduction: 4 seqs x 5 steps: sequential 24 forwards -> batch 6 forwards (1 packed prefill + 5 packed decode steps)
validation.wall_time_note: toy 32-hidden scale: forward is us-scale so wall time within noise; throughput mechanism is structural (shared GEMMs, 4x fewer forward invocations)
